sources.title: Japan-Russia diplomatic archives: 1855 Treaty of Shimoda and ratification exchange
sources.institution: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.coverage: Treaty signature on 7 February 1855, photographed ratification instrument, exchange of ratifications on 7 December 1856
sources.notes: Japanese MFA archival exhibition explicitly dates exchange of the Japan-Russia Treaty of Shimoda ratifications to 7 December 1856. The joint Japan-Russia foreign-ministry document compendium separately reproduces Article 2 boundary/status language.
